name: enumitem-xecjk-multiline
description: enumitem multiline labels collide with xeCJK's sbox boundary: inject the recovered \enit@postlabel@i deferral (RE enumitem_xecjk.rs).
tex:
% hjfy: enumitem-xecjk-multiline -- defer enumitem's multiline label reader past xeCJK's sbox boundary
\makeatletter\ExplSyntaxOn
\def\hjfy@expected@postlabel{\@ifnextchar\egroup{\aftergroup\enit@postlabel}{\enit@postlabel@i}}
\AddToHook{begindocument/before}{%
  \@ifpackageloaded{enumitem}{%
    \@ifpackageloaded{xeCJK}{%
      \ifx\enit@postlabel\hjfy@expected@postlabel
        \cs_if_exist:NT \__xeCJK_boundary_capture_resume: {%
          \let\hjfy@orig@postlabel@i\enit@postlabel@i
          \def\enit@postlabel@i#1{%
            \ifx#1\__xeCJK_boundary_capture_resume:
              \def\hjfy@next{\__xeCJK_boundary_capture_resume:\aftergroup\enit@postlabel}%
            \else
              \def\hjfy@next{\hjfy@orig@postlabel@i#1}%
            \fi
            \hjfy@next
          }%
          \typeout{hjfy:enumitem-xecjk-multiline}%
        }%
      \fi
    }{}%
  }{}%
}
\ExplSyntaxOff\makeatother
